description: This source file manages the configuration for hostapd, including loading, creating, modifying, and saving configurations related to WLAN access points and BSSs. It defines functions for parsing configuration files, creating configuration data structures, and manipulating key-value parameters within the configuration. It also handles internal data structures representing vap maps, configuration maps, and lists of access points.

classes.name: wld_hostapdVapInfo_t
classes.description: Structure representing VAP (Virtual Access Point) info, including BSS name, MAC address, and parameter map.

classes.name: wld_hostapd_config_t
classes.description: Main configuration structure containing header key-value map and list of VAPs.

methods.name: wld_hostapdVapInfo_t * s_createHostapdVapInfo(bool isInterface,char * bssName)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a vap info structure with interface flag and BSS name.

methods.name: void s_deleteHostapdVapInfo(wld_hostapdVapInfo_t * vapInfo)
methods.description: Deletes a vap info structure, freeing allocated resources.

methods.name: bool s_initConfig(wld_hostapd_config_t ** pConf,amxc_llist_t * pllAP)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a hostapd config structure from a list of access points.

methods.name: bool wld_hostapd_createConfig(wld_hostapd_config_t ** pConf,T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Creates hostapd configuration structure from radio and VAPs configuration.

methods.name: bool wld_hostapd_loadConfig(wld_hostapd_config_t ** conf,char * path)
methods.description: Loads configuration from a hostapd config file into internal data structures.

methods.name: bool wld_hostapd_deleteConfig(wld_hostapd_config_t * conf)
methods.description: Deletes a loaded hostapd configuration, freeing resources.

methods.name: bool wld_hostapd_writeConfig(wld_hostapd_config_t * conf,char * path)
methods.description: Writes the internal hostapd configuration back to a file.

methods.name: bool wld_hostapd_addConfigParam(wld_hostapd_config_t * conf,const char * bssName,const char * key,const char * value)
methods.description: Adds or updates a key/value parameter in the configuration.

methods.name: bool wld_hostapd_delConfigParam(wld_hostapd_config_t * conf,char * bssName,char * key)
methods.description: Deletes a key/value parameter from the configuration.

methods.name: swl_mapChar_t * wld_hostapd_getConfigMap(wld_hostapd_config_t * conf,char * bssName)
methods.description: Retrieves the map of configuration parameters for general or specific BSS.

methods.name: const char * wld_hostapd_getConfigParamValStr(wld_hostapd_config_t * conf,char * bssName,const char * key)
methods.description: Gets the value string of a configuration parameter.

methods.name: swl_mapChar_t * wld_hostapd_getConfigMapByBssid(wld_hostapd_config_t * conf,swl_macBin_t * bssid)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration map associated with a specific BSSID.

methods.name: const char * wld_hostapd_getConfigParamByBssidValStr(wld_hostapd_config_t * conf,swl_macBin_t * bssid,const char * key)
methods.description: Gets the value string for a specific parameter by BSSID.
